condition: In requests 2.32.x, a request to an IPv6 link-local URL that has a zone ID (e.g. https://[fe80::1%eth0]/) fails with NameResolutionError. The host is taken from urlparse().hostname without brackets and with the zone ID escaped as %25.
workaround: Build the request yourself with session.prepare_request(requests.Request(...)), set prepared.url = prepared.url.replace('%25', '%'), then call session.send(prepared). Downgrading to requests 2.31.0 also works.
